Project Context
Usably is an AI-driven user experience testing tool designed to help developers and product teams identify and fix usability issues in their web applications. This project is an AI-powered UX testing platform that simulates real user behavior in a browser-like environment to evaluate web applications end-to-end.

The system:

Programmatically navigates websites like a real user

Executes common UX flows (signup, login, checkout, forms, navigation)

Detects friction points (excessive clicks, unclear CTAs, slow interactions, broken flows)

Scores usability and experience quality

Generates actionable improvement tasks (e.g., Jira tickets, GitHub issues)

Optionally generates code-level fix suggestions or prompts
